data.body: **[P1] Finalize shutdown-time plugin fatals before releasing instances.** This check runs after `ExecutionManager` has closed, so a scope fatal reported during `close()` arrives after `onInvocationEnd` emitted `PENDING` or `SUCCEEDED` and after plugins were released. The invocation then fails while Insight/OTel permanently retain a stale outcome. Determine the final outcome before the single end-hook dispatch, release plugins afterward, and update the shutdown regression to expect one `RETRYING` event carrying the fatal.
